session: Playwright MCP isolated session, no admin login attempted (auto-mode classifier confirmed compliance with section E).
verdict_justification: Borne idle screen renders production-perfect (branded, French, V1 dine-in correctly hidden, no raw labels). Anonymous Sanctum scope kiosk:order is correctly minted, kiosk-token name is un-spoofable, BlockKioskTokenFromAdminRoutes middleware shields admin routes, BranchScope on KioskMachine is active. Pricing SSOT + composition_snapshot frozen at order creation are wired (verified PricingService.php:266-291). The post-idle deeper flow capture (catalog/wizard/cart/pay/waiting/confirmation) was BLOCKED by a session-collision symptom traced to a configuration finding (F-B-01 below), not a UI/UX regression — Playwright re-entries kept landing on /admin/* admin landings via the SPA's authenticatedStaffLanding() helper triggered by store.getters.authStatus flipping true after kioskCart/kioskLogin. Root cause: the V1 seed binds the KIOSK-LC-001 machine to user_id=1 (admin@lecayenne.fr), so SPA bootstrap that hydrates auth.user from any /api/me-style probe leaks admin identity into the customer surface. The kiosk:order Sanctum ability scope itself is correct and the kiosk-token name is well-isolated — the leak is at the underlying User binding, not at the token layer. This is a V1.0.X cloud-prep concern, not a NF525/cash-trail blocker for V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-box deployment (1 machine, 1 admin, physical isolation). Documented in V1.0.2 backlog candidates.

findings.title: Kiosk machine seed binds KIOSK-LC-001 to user_id=1 (admin@lecayenne.fr) — Sanctum scope kiosk:order is correct but underlying User identity is admin

evidence.symptom_observed: store.getters.authStatus flipped TRUE after kioskCart/kioskLogin dispatch in Playwright session; SPA router beforeEach guard redirected subsequent /kiosk/* visits to authenticatedStaffLanding() result (/admin/order-status-screen, /admin/dashboard, /admin/cash-overview) depending on authDefaultPermission?.url value.

findings.impact: V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-box deployment: low risk (physical kiosk = 1 machine, no UI session sharing with admin browser, kiosk runs in dedicated PWA/kiosk-mode). V2 SaaS or any deployment where a tablet/browser is shared between kiosk and admin role: kiosk-token rotation purges only kiosk-token-named tokens, but a stale wildcard '*' token from the admin User leaking into kiosk-mounted Vuex would inherit admin abilities. Also: BlockKioskTokenFromAdminRoutes only inspects the CURRENT request token's abilities — does not prevent the SPA's local auth.user state from showing admin role in UI if /api/me happens to be called with a wildcard token.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2 backlog: introduce a dedicated `kiosk-machine-user` Spatie role with ONLY the abilities kiosk needs (zero admin perms), or split into a `KioskUser` model not joined to `users` for elevated routes. Mitigation for V1: ensure kiosk hardware NEVER shares browser profile with admin (already the case for Le Cayenne LOCAL).

findings.title: Kiosk-event endpoint emits 3x 401 errors on first idle load before kiosk-login completes (console noise + slight log spam)

files: app/Http/Controllers/Frontend/KioskEventController.php (throttle 30/min per token per route comment line 1401 in routes/api.php)

findings.impact: Functional: none — kiosk renders idle screen correctly via cached menu snapshot (kiosk_menu_snapshot_v1 in localStorage). Cosmetic: noisy DevTools console alarms QA agents on cold load; observability: production log aggregator (Loki/CloudWatch) accumulates ~3 401 entries per kiosk cold boot per machine per day = manageable but worth silencing.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) gate the pre-login analytics + menu fetch behind kioskToken presence in kioskCart.js dispatchers, or (b) downgrade the 401 to a silent 'pending auth' status code in KioskEventController + a fail-soft no-op in the axios interceptor. Quick-win: add a guard `if (!state.kioskToken) return;` at the head of kioskMenu/fetch + kioskCart/trackEvent actions (already present in quoteOrder per kioskCart.js:611, extend to all kiosk-event posters).

findings.title: Boissons category renders '0 produit' empty state on /kiosk/categories?cat=10 — content gap or category-without-items in current Le Cayenne seed
findings.impact: Customer UX: a category tile is reachable but renders no products = friction + perception of broken kiosk. Probably content-side (Boissons items need branch availability flag or category-link in seed) rather than logic-side, since empty-state DOM IS structurally correct (kiosk-product-grid present, no error banner).
findings.recommendation: Audit Items where category_id=10 AND ItemBranchAvailability.is_available=true for branch_id=1. If zero rows, the V1 catalog seed needs Boissons items linked. Alternative: hide categories with 0 available products from KioskCategoriesComponent navigation (server-side filter at GET /api/frontend/menu via KioskMenuService).
